svg.title: AutoDQA target architecture — sandbox as sole executor
svg.desc: A structural diagram of the AutoDQA target architecture. A LangGraph orchestration loop sits at the center. Upward, it routes model calls through Cloudflare AI Gateway to Amazon Bedrock. Downward, it routes execution requests through an MCP broker, which consults a dataset registry as policy and dispatches the job to a single Cloudflare sandbox. The sandbox is the sole executor and reaches the read-only CDW and the documentation store itself. Numbered arrows trace the agent loop.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does Cloudflare AI Gateway enforce on model calls?')
sendPrompt('What does Amazon Bedrock do in this architecture?')
sendPrompt('What makes the LangGraph orchestration loop the trusted zone?')
g.text: No DB creds · no model code
